reviews.author: Pam Rackley
reviews.text: First time using them and will not be the last. Everyone was great to work with, on time, priced well, knowledgeable and friendly. Highly recommend and will use again

reviews.author: Charles Reid
reviews.text: Good people....fair pricing...and will come tow you from almost anywhere..not just me but have several friends who have used there service...highly recommended

reviews.author: Lloyd Morrison
reviews.text: Awesome service! I broke down at midnight on my way home from work called them up (after calling 4 others that said it was after there hours or would be several hours before they could get me) they came right out and towed me home for a very fair price! The wrecker personel was clean and very polite. These folks are now my go-to for any more related issues.

reviews.author: michelle roden
reviews.text: I highly recommend this tow company! I was traveling on 58 when I rock flew up and shattered my driver window. Needless to say I was very shaken up and knew I had to tow my car home but was very fortunate that my driver and his dispatch communicated with each other very well with my distress at the moment. And I didn't have to wait long and was treated with most the up most respect. Thank you seriously from the bottom of my heart.

reviews.author: Mitchell Homestead
reviews.text: They helped me in a tough time when my trailer axle blew out. Even though they knew, and I have to embarrassingly admit, that it was my lack of proper maintenance that caused the problem with my trailer they didn't make me feel foolish about it. They helped me limp my trailer with a heavy load on it safetly to their lot and let me stay there until my load was rescued by another driver. I will use them again without a doubt if I am anywhere near their service area and I need the help. Their employees were very helpful and friendly.

reviews.author: John Miller
reviews.text: Awesome 50+ ton wreckers. The lady at front desk was very cordial and introduced me to the owner of this very successful 18 year old business. The owner helped me get in touch with an owner of a property a client of mine is interested in. Great well run business by people who are invested in the business and each other!

reviews.author: James Murdock
reviews.text: I want to start off with they were good about getting the car off of 58 and towing it for a reasonable price. I asked them if they work on cars . They said they do so I told them to take a look at it and get ack with me with what’s wrong with the car. The car broke down on Sunday the 9 of June. Just cut off. They came back and said on Tuesday it was the gas pump . So I ask if I was to buy the gas pump could they put it in the car . They said that would be fine to save me a little money on helping my son. Then a couple of days later after I had already dropped the gas pump off. They tell me it’s the ECU board went bad that’s what caused the problems. So they ordered one off of eBay for me with was nice. They call me to tell me the car is ready on Tuesday the 25 of June. Before the car broke down the car was idling fine , gas gauge was working currently, transmission was shifting ok. The transmission was not in great shape but was acting no were as bad as it is now, The car setting still wants to cut off. Engine light is on now . The car has more problems known than it did before this all started. I am out $350 some dollars. My son still can’t get to work with it. Know I have to find another auto mechanic to find out what coursed all the issues that the car has know that it didn’t have before we started. Top it off they said they gave me a good deal on labor. I am in worst shape know than when we started

reviews.author: Kenneth Halsey
reviews.text: They came and got me very fast. Set it up over the phone and wrecker came right to me. The driver was great and made sure to take care of my vehicle.

reviews.author: Michelle Marrs
reviews.text: One of the best experiences I have had during my trucking industry history. They were very friendly, professional and responded to the situation in a very timely manner!! I would highly recommend them!!

reviews.author: Angela Smith
reviews.text: I was in a bad situation on the side of a very busy highway and they came within 15 minutes of me calling. Very professional and courteous. Highly recommend them!!

reviews.author: JPHTHREE
reviews.text: My wife's car broke down with a fuel issue. Brinkley's towed the vehicle cheaper than anyone else we called. We were initially concerned that the vehicle would not be repaired in time for my wife's trip. Mr. Brinkley called me and assured me that his mechanics would work diligently to assist us. Brinkley's was able to disassemble and purge the fuel system in a timely manner and get my wife's vehicle running better than before. Brinkley's charge for the towing and repair was way below what could have been expected. Brinkley's Wrecker and Repair seemed like a honest, family based business that was very professional yet very humble. I would recommend them to anyone in need of auto towing or repair in the Suffolk area. Thank you Brinkley's.

reviews.author: Pat Cray-Hollis
reviews.text: Called for tow a van from Deep Creek to Suffolk. Said truck was out on a call. I called back around 1:30 said needing tow said it will be two hours. She will call me back. Never heard from them again.

reviews.author: David Fox
reviews.text: Driver was fantastic. Got me out and on my a way quickly . Hopefully won't need a tow again . But if I do I'm hanging on to they're phone number.

reviews.author: Sherry Rumpf
reviews.text: They arrived before their estimated time. Took care of business. Much appreciated since I work out of the area.

reviews.author: Setzuna Rivera
reviews.text: Best wrecker service in the 757 area. Great prices. They work hard and do great work. They are truly a 24/7 365.

reviews.author: Brian Rod
reviews.text: These guys were great broke down on route 58 between Franklin and Suffolk and they were there within 45 minutes to pick me up.A + service from their tow truck driver to their front office

reviews.author: J. L. Mason
reviews.text: All Truckers With Breakdowns or incidents on Highway 58 in between Suffolk & emporia and further call Brinkley's. They Do Light Mechanical, Fuel Delivery, & Of Course Heavy Towing.

reviews.author: Hakan Ertekin
reviews.text: Asked for a tow truck at 1130....said they'll have one at 1:00....didn't call me until 4:00....entire day wasted
